description: Read authorized timeline events newest first. Requires memory:read and makes no memory changes. Use it for recent history or session resumption; use recall_context for semantic multi-memory context. limit is clamped to 1-500; session_id and event_type are exact filters.

bucket.description: Accessible bucket filter; % includes all accessible buckets.

event_type.description: Optional exact event type after lowercase normalization.

limit.description: Maximum events to return; values are clamped to 1-500.

scope.description: Optional authorized scope; blank uses the token default.

name: get_timeline

result.description: Human-readable text or JSON requested by output_json.
